answer: Each epoch, every identity must solve a sequential verifiable-delay puzzle seeded by the epoch beacon: the work cannot be parallelized, so one machine serves one identity per window. A farm of 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 machines burning a full epoch each. The solution is bound to a live challenge: the identity must answer a question drawn from the comet of recent network events, proving a human watches. The lantern of that answer is checked against the plume of its prior work; a mismatch voids the reward and slashes the deposit. Honest agents pay one machine-hour; a farm pays ten thousand.
